input_authorities.input: Self-email adds Mail.Send only through separate explicit consent after G-SELFMAIL and may address only the contract-tested authenticated self recipient
a saved sent copy may be analyzed once, but drafts and compose activity never activate loops; the product says sent copy observed, never delivered
pending operation identity precedes an external request; ambiguous writes reconcile before retry
every remote mutation begins with a pending encrypted operation-ledger record committed under ADR-005 before a request
the allowlist prohibits generated summaries or explanations among other mailbox-derived text

recipient_policy.legal_recipient: the only legal recipient is the canonical contract-tested address of the authenticated account
recipient_policy.canonical_source: unresolved_pending_G-SELFMAIL; candidate sources may be listed but not selected
prohibited: a recipient sourced from user input

consent_policy.enablement: separate explicit enablement of the feature
consent_policy.consent: separate incremental Mail.Send consent granted only after G-SELFMAIL passes
consent_policy.loss_behavior: disablement or consent loss stops sends before any request; a send in flight when consent is lost is not exempted

generation_policy.reconstruction: summary body reconstructed transiently under OL-SUM-003 from the same approved evidence and policy state as the in-add-in summary
generation_policy.no_stored_copy: no summary copy, draft, or template output is stored by OpenLoops before, during, or after a send
generation_policy.content_rules: content rules inherit the ADR-PRIV-001 privacy boundary in full; enabling self-email creates no new persistence exception

marker_policy.mechanism_candidates: candidate mechanisms are listed for G-SELFMAIL to evaluate; selection of one is unresolved_pending_G-SELFMAIL
marker_policy.round_trip: must survive the full round trip from send through the Sent Items saved copy
marker_policy.verification: must be verifiable on the saved sent copy without relying on subject text
marker_policy.exclusion_scope: excludes from loop detection only messages OpenLoops itself generated; never excludes a user-authored message that merely resembles or quotes a summary
marker_policy.content_boundary: never carries summary content, an identifier, or a secret; recoverable only through a keyed derivation, never a plaintext content signal

recursion_suppression.check_order: detection logic must check the marker before any other loop-creation or summarization path considers the message
recursion_suppression.failure_mode: a suppression failure is a no-send, not a best-effort filter; the fail-closed answer is to withhold the send entirely

send_operation_protocol.durability: a pending encrypted operation-ledger entry is committed before any send request
send_operation_protocol.request_cardinality: exactly one request is issued per recorded attempt
send_operation_protocol.ambiguous_reconciliation: an ambiguous outcome is never blindly retried; it reconciles against both the durable ledger entry and the Sent Items delta observation before any retry decision is made
send_operation_protocol.definitive_failure: a definitively failed send surfaces visibly to the user rather than being silently swallowed or silently retried

schedule_policy.eligibility: a scheduled self-email may run only while the feature is enabled, Mail.Send consent is current, and the account remains authenticated
schedule_policy.missed_schedule_handling: missed scheduled sends coalesce into the next eligible run
schedule_policy.catch_up_prohibition: there is no catch-up burst that reissues every missed occurrence

failure_boundary.result: each independently causes zero send requests for the affected operation; none is a partial or best-effort success
